rule.description: Specialized agents MUST be used for all non-trivial tasks. Check AGENT-REGISTRY.md before starting any complex work.

context-strategy.main-thread: coordination, decisions, user interaction, success/failure reporting
context-strategy.agent-threads: file reading, code search, test execution, multi-file ops, verbose processing

return-rules.rule: Return only actionable insights — max 20% of processed data
Never dump raw output, logs, or full search results to main thread
Summarize findings; focus on decisions needed

enforcement.rule: Before ANY complex task — check AGENT-REGISTRY.md for specialist
If specialist exists — USE IT. No exceptions.
Parallel agents allowed and encouraged for independent work streams

violations.violation: Doing complex work in main thread when specialist agent exists
Skipping agent lookup for non-trivial tasks
